title: Implement Rust Dev And Local Kits
description: Implement the first concrete kit-kind slice in semio/rs, with any minimal semio/hub changes only if strictly required later. Focus this ticket on Rust dev kits (full embedded JSON file) and local kits (.semio/kit.db SQLite snapshot plus regular files). Reuse the existing KitStore JSON and SQLite boundaries, add filesystem helpers for JSON-file load/save and folder-kit load/save, and extend the existing tests in semio/rs/src/lib.rs. Do not create new test files. This is the first implementation step of the broader kit architecture plan.
